title: Lobby-Core
description: A fully modular premium lobby core for Paper 1.21.10 with advanced systems like lobby items, NPCs, regions, scoreboard, server navigator and full in-game configuration.
body:
# 🏆 LobbyCore – Premium Lobby System

LobbyCore is a next-generation **all-in-one lobby system** designed for modern Minecraft networks.

Built for **Paper 1.20x (Java 21)**, it delivers a fully modular, high-performance and fully in-game configurable lobby experience.

---

## ⚡ Why LobbyCore?

Most lobby plugins are limited, outdated or require multiple addons.

LobbyCore replaces them ALL with one unified system.

✔ High performance  
✔ Fully configurable in-game  
✔ Network-ready architecture  
✔ Velocity support  
✔ Clean modular design  

---

## 🎮 Core Features

### 🎒 Lobby Items System
Fully in-game editable lobby items.

- Change item material
- Edit name, lore, slot
- Assign actions
- GUI editor: `/lobby items`

Supported actions:
- Server Selector
- Profile
- Cosmetics
- Settings
- Lobby Switcher
- Command execution
- Messages
- Open GUIs

---

### 🌍 Server Navigator
Modern server selector GUI.

- Live player counts
- Server status
- Descriptions
- Velocity integration
- One-click connect

---

### 👤 Profile System
Command: `/profile`

Displays:
- Rank
- Playtime
- PlaceholderAPI support

---

### 📊 Scoreboard System
Modern animated scoreboard

- Multiple layouts
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Network stats
- Discord display

---

### 🧱 Region System
WorldEdit-style region system

- Define regions with pos1 / pos2
- Lobby protection zones
- Launchpad zones

---

### 🚀 Launchpads & Double Jump
- Configurable strength
- Sounds & particles
- Region-based activation
- Cooldowns

---

### 👥 Player Visibility System
Switch visibility modes:

- All players
- Hidden

---

### 📰 News System
Broadcast system across multiple channels:

- Chat
- Bossbar
- Holograms
- Auto rotation

---

### ✨ Holograms
- RGB + MiniMessage support
- Animations
- PlaceholderAPI support

---

### 🛡 Lobby Protection
Fully configurable protection system:

- Block break/place prevention
- Damage disable
- Hunger disable
- Item drop/pickup control

---

### ⚙ Admin Setup GUI
Everything in one panel:

- Lobby Items
- NPCs
- Regions
- Scoreboard
- News
- Settings

---

### 🌐 Velocity Support
- Network-wide player counts
- Server switching
- Status indicators
- Ping display

---

### 🌍 Multi-Language
- German (DE)
- English (EN)
- Fully extendable

---

## 🗄 Database Support

- SQLite (default)
- MySQL (optional)
- HikariCP connection pooling

Stores:
- Players
- NPCs
- Regions
- News
- Settings
- Layouts

---

## 🔌 API Support

- PlaceholderAPI
- LuckPerms
- Vault
- Velocity
- MiniMessage
- Adventure API

---

## ⚙ Commands

- `/lobby items`
- `/lobby setup`
- `/lobby doublejump`
- `/lobby launchpad`
- `/profile`
- `/npc`
- `/news`
- `/hologram`

---

## 💡 Requirements

- Java 21
- Paper 1.21.10+

## ----------------------------------
## Installation

1. Download LobbyCore-1.0.jar
2. Place into /plugins folder
3. Restart server
4. Configure files in /plugins/LobbyCore/
5. Use /lobby setup for in-game configuration
